plans.selection: Preserve EVERY inner-validation positive caught by event-hybrid at .8; require at least 20% fewer inner false alerts; minimize FP, maximize TP, prefer declaration order then threshold nearest .8. Otherwise baseline .8. Separate baseline-only threshold control. No outer labels used for selection.
plans.limitations: Development corpus already informed feature design. Nested selection is not a new prospective test. Known families only; new related audio can remain. Final fits are not validation. Scores are uncalibrated.
